Garage description
An enhanced digital paint with a pattern that is intended to distract and disorient your enemy, making them more likely to miss when firing at you.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on August 26, 2010.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Prodigi was worth 192,500 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Marshal.
Legacy paint description:
A universal paint that provides protection from Firebird, Railgun, Thunder and Shaft. Works well at any range and masks your tank by giving it a minimalist pattern.
